subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: Which open fix path should own the remaining model-visible tool-result loss after PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99756 only removed the image-placeholder symptom?
rationale: The issue is real and current, but the latest field report says the narrow patch still leaves unreadable empty output, so maintainer judgment is needed on whether to land it as partial mitigation or wait for a broader root-cause repair.

options.title: Prioritize root-cause fix
options.body: Treat PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99756 as partial and require PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795 or an equivalent live-proven fix before closing this issue.

options.title: Land partial mitigation first
options.body: Accept the narrow placeholder improvement while keeping this issue open for the remaining empty-output failure mode.

options.title: Request payload capture first
options.body: Pause implementation decisions until a failing provider-submitted payload is captured and compared with session JSONL and trajectory state.

recommendation.title: Prioritize root-cause fix
recommendation.body: Treat PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99756 as partial and require PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100795 or an equivalent live-proven fix before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the broader open maintainer-labelled PR that targets payload-less media blocks and fresh tool-result sanitization.
